title: plan.json (contract 1)
description: The plan file at agent_plans/<plan>/plan.json. Its presence is what makes a folder a plan. Unknown keys are ignored by readers. See core/contract/contract.md.

contract.description: Contract version. Always 1 in this version of the contract.

name.description: Plan name; by convention the name of the plan folder. Not checked: readers use the folder name, so a value that differs is not an error.

source.description: Path of the document the plan was mapped from, relative to the repository root, or null when the plan came from a conversation.

language.description: Language of the plan's free text (not of the contract). Documented values: pt-BR, en. Readers default to pt-BR when absent; any other value picks the table by the contract's language rule (ignoring case, then by base language, else English).

profile.description: Template profile. Documented values: full, lean. Readers default to full when absent.

scripts_version.description: Version of the plan scripts (status.sh, task.sh, map.sh) the plan received; compare with the '# scripts_version: <N>' stamp on disk.
